story: Ivan and his grandfather go to a community club. They meet a friendly American woman there. Everybody in the club is very happy.
title: The Community Club
setting: A bright community center with many people.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Grandfather
characters.look: An old man with white hair and glasses.

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: A kind woman with long black hair and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Ivan is at a new club.
sentences.zh: 伊万在一个新俱乐部里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt, stands in front of a community building.

sentences.en: His grandfather walks slowly beside him.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父慢慢地走在他身边。
sentences.scene_prompt: An old man with white hair and glasses walks next to Ivan.

sentences.en: They invite a friendly American woman.
sentences.zh: 他们邀请了一位友好的美国女子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan and his grandfather talk to Maya, a woman with long black hair and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Maya is a kind Russian friend.
sentences.zh: 玛雅是一位善良的俄罗斯朋友。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya, a woman with long black hair and a green sweater, smiles at Ivan.

sentences.en: Everybody has a very big smile.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一个灿烂的微笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: A group of different people in a room are all smiling happily.

sentences.en: The British police officer visits them.
sentences.scene_prompt: A police officer in a dark uniform stands near the group of people.

sentences.en: Her son plays with a tiger.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子玩着一只老虎。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small boy plays with a small orange toy tiger on the floor.

sentences.en: He sees a very bright star.
sentences.zh: 他看到一颗非常明亮的星星。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small boy looks up at a bright yellow star shape on the wall.
